independence: Picked from the episode transcript, shot list, video keyframes and the Ep1/Ep2 maps (names) only; no creator Shorts/Reels were opened or searched for.

coverage.note: Whole episode read in order. Excluded: 0:00-0:18 B2P logo + GIRLS HOSTEL / EPISODE 03 title cards, 1:12-1:16 4 s flash-recap of Dhana's Ep2 lines inside the warden scene, 3:44-4:25 song, 6:39-6:48 song, 7:51-8:03 song, 9:37-9:45 song, 13:24-13:48 end credits.

notes: Girls Hostel 2.0 (B2P Studios) Ep3. CANDIDATE picks for the clip-judge filter (founder process 2026-10-07): proposed generously, every clip ends on a beat. Names carried from Ep1/Ep2: Akshara (green top this episode), Meenakshi (orange kurta here; married; holds some leverage over Dhana), Ekta (maroon top, curly hair), Dhana (rich roommate, black top at the cafe), Jai (Akshara's delivery-partner friend), the warden. New: Tarun (Jai's drinking friend on the terrace), Dhana's boyfriend (man in blue at the cafe, unnamed). Scribe speaker ids unreliable; speakers assigned from content and frames. Option-2 cutting: time_segments are the cut; pieces are the words inside them.

clips.title: Six months advance ఇచ్చాక చెప్తున్నారా? | one rupee కూడా తిరిగి రాదు
clips.why: Akshara to the warden: 'you tell me after taking six months advance?'; she names Dhana as the one behind it; warden: 'leave first, and per terms not one rupee comes back'. Her stunned face.
clips.payoff_line: మీతో ఏదన్నా problem వచ్చి పంపించవలసి వస్తే one rupee కూడా తిరిగి రాదని
clips.payoff_type: hard line (no refund) with her stunned reaction (102-103)
clips.notes: Starts at 64.4 on 'Madam six months advance ఇచ్చిన తర్వాత చెప్తున్నారు' (shot cut 62.2 / 66.4). Contains the show's own 4 s flash of Dhana's Ep2 lines (72.5-76.2, 'నీకు ఈ Zomato bags…') as Akshara's realisation; it is in the transcript as words and plays inside the clip. Ends at 104.0 on the shot cut after Akshara's stunned face and Ekta's 'ఏయ్! దానికి call చేయి' (102.9-104.0): the judge may prefer ending at 101.5 on the warden's line. Payoff is a hard line, likely 3. 'అది మిమ్మల్ని బెదిరించిందో లేకపోతే డబ్బులు ఇచ్చిందో గానీ' = whether she threatened you or paid you.

clips.title: Discussion అయిపోయింది… two minutes లో వాళ్లే call చేసి చెప్తారు
clips.why: Meenakshi to Dhana on the phone: 'stop this decently or not?'; hangs up: 'Akshara, let's go, discussion over'. Warden: 'over?!' 'Those who should tell you will call in two minutes.' Her phone rings.
clips.payoff_line: మీకెవరైతే అయిపోయింది అని చెప్పాలో వాళ్లే two minutes లో call చేసి చెప్తారు
clips.payoff_type: mic-drop line + visual payoff (warden's phone rings, she answers, 228-232)
clips.notes: Starts on the shot cut 191.1 with Meenakshi's 'నేను కూడా నీ విషయంలో ఏం చేయలేను' (addresses Dhana; cryptic, so hook 3: it hints she holds something over Dhana, which Dhana's 'ప్రతిసారి ఆ matter కే వస్తావ్' confirms). Keeps the 7 s silent beat 203.3-210.2 (Dhana's worried face, music) before 'అక్షర రా పోదాం'. Ends at 232.5 on the shot cut after the warden answers her phone under the song (visual confirmation of the line), 8 s hold. Spoiler: reveals that Meenakshi can make Dhana back off. Who is on which end of the call is inferred from frames 3:16-3:24 (Meenakshi on phone, Dhana worried). Speaker ids are all '2' here.

clips.title: సరే topper గారు… అందరికీ మన life అంటే joke నే
clips.why: Akshara teases 'okay topper sir'; Jai snaps back that their life is a joke to everyone ('after all'), and that changing it is in actions, not words; she apologises.
clips.payoff_line: అది చెప్పడంలో కాదు చేసే పనుల్లో కూడా ఉండాలి… / Sorry రా ఇంకెప్పుడు చేయను okay నా
clips.payoff_type: quotable line then a soft apology (relief beat)
clips.notes: Cafe scene (Jai, Akshara). Ends on the shot cut 394.58 right after her 'okay నా' (Jai's 'సరే afternoon classes…' tail dropped). The strongest line ('అది చెప్పడంలో కాదు చేసే పనుల్లో కూడా ఉండాలి') is 7 s before the end; the judge may call the apology ending a 3. ASR: 'ఏం topper ఓ ఏమో పావులకు కూడా ఉపయోగం లేదు' ~ 'పావలాకు కూడా ఉపయోగం లేదు' (not worth a quarter). The longer motivational stretch from 314.0 ('అలాంటోళ్లందరికీ మన success తో సమాధానం చెప్పాలి') was not cut because it ends on 'ఊ good'.

clips.title: Revenge తీసుకునే capacity ఉంది… కానీ ఆ Meenakshi మధ్యలో వచ్చింది
clips.why: Dhana to her boyfriend: 'I have the capacity for revenge… I was getting the girl thrown out and Meenakshi stepped in.' 'Why does that stop you?' 'She knows what happened in my life before.'
clips.payoff_line: దానికేగా ముందు నా life లో జరిగిన matter గురించి తెలుసు
clips.payoff_type: reveal line (why Dhana obeys Meenakshi) that reframes the clip
clips.notes: Starts at 498.0 on Dhana's 'మనకొకరి మీద కోపం ఉంది…' (a striking statement, not addressed to him: hook 3; 'ఉఫ్ ఏమైంది అలా ఉన్నావ్?' at 496.8 was left out as small talk). Ends on the shot cut 518.7 right after the reveal. Spoiler: states that Meenakshi holds Dhana's secret. The man in blue (frames 8:00-9:36) is unnamed; 'Akshara', 'Meenakshi', 'warden' are named inside the clip. 20.7 s. ASR: 'ఇంట్రూడల్ friends' unclear.

clips.title: Sudden గా మందు మానేసావ్? | Akshara చెప్పిందేమో అనుకున్నా
clips.why: Tarun: 'why did you suddenly quit drinking?' Jai: 'just till exams'. Tarun: 'thought Akshara told you'. Jai: 'well, that's also true'. 'Say that first!' Jai: 'she only said no drinking till exams'.
clips.payoff_line: ఊ అది చెప్పేదేమో ముందు / రేయ్ రేయ్ తనే మొత్తానికి మానేయమని చెప్పలేదు exams వరకు తాగొద్దని చెప్పింది
clips.notes: Terrace, Jai and Tarun with a bottle (frames 9:45-10:04). 24 s; ends on the shot cut 609.5 (song follows). Akshara is named but her relation to Jai is not stated: standalone 3. Weak payoff (no laugh beat); low confidence, included as the only Jai-Tarun banter that ends cleanly.

clips.title: తాగుతున్నావా? ఉండు video call చేస్తున్నా…
clips.why: Akshara: 'are you drinking?' Jai: 'not me, him'. She video-calls to check, then scolds Tarun for drinking in front of a guy preparing for exams; Tarun mumbles and sheepishly walks off with the bottle.
clips.payoff_line: At least వాడికి exams ఉన్నాయని తెలుసు కదా / అది… ఉమ్ అరేయ్ (Tarun leaves with the bottle)
clips.payoff_type: comic reaction: Tarun silenced, gets up and leaves (frames 668-674)
clips.notes: Starts at 627.8 on 'తాగుతున్నావా?' (shot cut 626.6; the 'Hello / ఏం చేస్తున్నావ్ / Tarun వస్తే terrace మీద కూర్చున్నాం' phone small talk before it is dropped, so Tarun is first named at 651.4 'Hi Akshara బాగున్నావా? / కాదు Tarun…'). Ends at 676.5 after Tarun walks away under the song sting (672.9-676.7), before Jai's 'ఏంటే feel అవుతాడు కదా'. ASR: 'యబ్బా నా మీద వేస్తావేంట్రా' is Tarun protesting; 'నేనుంటారా ఉమ్ అరేయ్' is Tarun's mumble. The later drunk-Tarun ladder gag (688-697) is too garbled in ASR to cut with confidence.

clips.title: Jai ని love చేయట్లేదా? love అని బొందా! | Akshara అంటే నాకు చాలా ఇష్టం రా
clips.why: Meenakshi: 'won't you two marry?' Akshara: 'love? nonsense, he's a childhood friend'. Cut to Jai: 'honestly, I like Akshara a lot'. Meenakshi: 'maybe Jai likes you' - 'impossible, don't I know Jai?'
clips.payoff_line: నిజం చెప్పాలంటే Akshara అంటే నాకు చాలా ఇష్టం రా… / Jai కి నువ్వంటే ఇష్టం ఉండొచ్చు కదా / impossible, Jai గురించి నాకు తెలీదా?
clips.payoff_type: reveal (Jai's confession) capped by dramatic-irony punchline with a laugh beat (801)
clips.notes: Continuous 64.6 s; the show's own intercutting between the hostel room (Meenakshi/Akshara) and the terrace (Tarun/Jai) is kept as is, including the 3 s song bridge 784-787 before Jai's confession. Starts at 746.4 (shot cut 744.6) on Meenakshi's direct tease. Ends at 811.0 (cut 811.2, credits follow) after Akshara's 'impossible' and the Jai/Akshara reaction intercut (804-808). SPOILER: Jai's feelings. The earlier 'control లో పెట్టుకున్నావ్… పెళ్లి అయితే అంతే పాపం / పెళ్లా?' setup (702-727) was left out to keep it under 75 s; ASR 'love అని బొందా' = 'love, my foot'. Tarun's 'ఒట్టేసి చెప్పురా' is on the terrace.

clips.title: Jai ని అంతలా control లో పెట్టుకున్నావ్… ఇంకా పెళ్లి అయితే అంతే పాపం
clips.why: Meenakshi: 'poor Jai, you've got him so under control; if you marry, he's done for'. 'Marriage?! love? nonsense, he's a childhood friend.' Comic denial beat (no confession).

cut_reasons.1: Drops the 19 s terrace intercut (Tarun's 'sorry, your lover…' / Jai's 'Akshara నా lover ఏంట్రా?') so the room conversation runs straight: 'పెళ్లా? పెళ్లి ఏంటి?' -> 'అదేంటి మీరు పెళ్లి చేసుకోకుండా ఇలానే ఉంటారా?'

clips.payoff_line: love అని బొందా! వాడు చిన్నప్పటి నుంచి మంచి close friend నాకు అంతే
clips.payoff_type: flat denial line (comic), no laugh beat
clips.notes: Non-spoiler alternative to w07 that stays in the room; ends on Akshara's denial at 766.1 (shot cut), which the judge may score 3 (a stance line). The internal cut at 727.2 -> 746.4 lands on shot cuts (727.2 sting / 744.6) and the dialogue reads continuous. Keep at most one of w07/w08.
